_about: Who made each shipped library asset, and under what licence (batch 2, R 10-07: library per-asset credits now). Keyed by library path; a key ending in / is the default for everything under it that has no entry of its own. Every line here is from eidoverse-video/CREDITS.md (the library's own attribution file, read 2026-10-07); nothing is guessed. `gap` says what that file doesn't say, for R (or the library's maintainer) to fill in. Roles: model, texture, rig, animation, avatar, character design, photo, sound, music, voice, font, generated-with, retopology, uploaded-by. Licences are SPDX ids where the file names a version; 'CC-BY (version not stated)' where it doesn't.

eidoverse/assets/models/.basis: CREDITS.md: the models are 'either handmade work by me (x.com/skyesharkie) or meshy.ai generations. All provided CC0, though attribution is appreciated on handmade (easy to tell which)'
eidoverse/assets/models/.gap: which models are handmade (by the maintainer, skyesharkie) and which are meshy.ai generations isn't recorded per file
